verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm that Claude accepts uploaded images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP) and screenshots pasted from the clipboard. They also say it analyzes visual elements such as images, charts and graphics in PDFs, which covers the core of sharing visuals for interpretation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of accuracy when interpreting standalone screenshots and photos, evidence of direct photo capture or upload from mobile, and independent or hands-on corroboration of image-understanding quality.
